blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Three players won the ₱15 million MegaLotto 6/45 jackpot on Friday, Oct. 23, 2026, while no player bagged the ₱430.86 million UltraLotto 6/58 jackpot, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. MegaLotto 6/45 draw result: 01-02-25-07-19-03 Jackpot prize: ₱15 million UltraLotto 6/58 draw result: 14-38-44-25-52-47. Jackpot prize: ₱430.86 million Minor games The PCSO also reported the following results for the minor lottery games drawn Friday: Draw schedule UltraLotto 6/58 draws are held every Tuesday, Friday and Sunday, with the next scheduled draw on Sunday, Oct. 25.
